bundle.shortDescription: The all-in-one shortcut manager. With a cat.
bundle.longDescription: Cat Key manages your keyboard shortcuts across every app on Windows and macOS: remap keys, per app if you like, learn any app's shortcuts, and level up with an animated cat.
